OVERVIEW

4799) [battle_book / message_22]
EMOTIONS can determine how effective an attack is.\! HAPPY beats ANGRY...\! ANGRY beats SAD...\! and SAD beats HAPPY!<br><br>EMOTIONS also affect different STATS for both friends and foes.\! Please refer to the EMOTION CHART in your IMPORTANT POCKET for an easy visual.

4800) [battle_book / message_300]
In addition, the EMOTIONS of defeated foes can grant bonus effects.\! HAPPY foes have a higher item and CLAM drop rate, while ANGRY foes will give out more EXP.<br>Sadly, SAD foes don't have any extra bonuses, but are typically easier to defeat.

4801) [battle_book / message_23]
HAPPY

4802) [battle_book / message_24]
A HAPPY friend/foe will have increased LUCK and SPEED, but a lowered HIT RATE.

4803) [battle_book / message_25]
When a friend/foe is even more HAPPY, they become ECSTATIC.

4804) [battle_book / message_26]
An ECSTATIC friend/foe's LUCK and SPEED are increased even further, but HIT RATE also lowers accordingly.

4805) [battle_book / message_27]
SAD

4806) [battle_book / message_28]
A SAD friend/foe will have increased DEFENSE, but decreased SPEED.\! Part of the damage that would be dealt to HEART is dealt to JUICE instead.

4807) [battle_book / message_29]
When a friend/foe is even more SAD, they become DEPRESSED.

4808) [battle_book / message_30]
A DEPRESSED friend/foe has an even higher DEFENSE and an even lower SPEED.\! Part of the damage that would be dealt to HEART is dealt to JUICE instead.

ANGRY
